summary: Backcountry tourer buried and killed in an avalanche on Green Mountain above Express Creek; the group, staying at the Markley Hut near Ashcroft, located and extricated the buried skier and attempted CPR without success.
notes: CAIC preliminary report: group of six backcountry tourers staying at the Markley Hut involved in the slide ~10:20 a.m. Monday; only one was buried and killed. Victim identity not published in sources read. merged KVNU/ABC Radio 2019 story ("1 dead in avalanche outside Aspen", sheriff said Monday; Green Mountain ~11,200 ft north-northeast slope, Markley Hut group, CAIC preliminary report) run 802.
